The game will take place after events of the first game, however playing the first game won't be necessary as location and the people involved are all different. Some events you'll appreciate a bit more though, if you know the context to them, such as the plague.

notes.title: Announcing my upcoming lewd humor RPG!
notes.content:
Helga: Euphorium's Song is the first part in a new saga about a floating continent of Euphorium. Because Euphorium is isolated from everything else, the people of Euphorium have become quite strange over the years and very open about their sexualities and their deviancy. However, this floating continent is now threatened by an ancient allmighty being that has arrived and only a group of brave adventurers may save the day.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/965390/Helga_Euphoriums_Song/

notes.title: Important Linux update!
notes.content:
Greetings Linux users! After long time and many trials, the file structure of Border of her Heart Linux version was totally changed including the deployement method. This huge update for Linux users should make the game playable if you used to have problems before.

Thank you from your patience and understanding, this took a lot of hard work and testing to get working. I hope you'll have fun playing Border of her Heart!

notes.title: Free Full HD DLC announcement
notes.content:
Hello all, thank you for your interest and support of my first ever VN. The reception has been so positive that I want to give a small treat to you all; I'm currently making a free DLC that'll increase the base game resolution to Full 1080p with bigger character models and better support for Widescreen resolutions. Again, this will be 100% free and everyone who has bought the game can opt in the DLC when it's released.


You can see some of the screens that I posted on my twitter feed here.

https://twitter.com/GamesTuomo/status/964810847875993600
https://twitter.com/GamesTuomo/status/965372855335772161


Thanks from your support again, you're all awesome!

EDIT: Added another screenshot, this time of the covergirl Wren.
